from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document entry extracted for case cause analysis."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The case cause (案由) or legal relationship identified in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., 行政判决书，民事裁定书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentDocument]
